entries.thesis: The strategic moat is the SUPPLIER NETWORK, not single-company carbon accounting. Each invited supplier expands the data graph and is a potential customer (their own Scope 3) → network effects that point tools (Plan A, Normative) and enterprise suites (Watershed, Sweep, Persefoni) lack.

productRisks: Supplier RESPONSE-RATE dependency — the whole network model collapses if invited suppliers don't submit; mitigate via AI extraction + low-friction portal.
Positioning tension: SME self-serve vs enterprise (Watershed/Persefoni) — focus risk.
Security: open HIGH xlsx vuln on the supplier data-import path undermines enterprise trust (see sec-xlsx-replace).
Regulatory whiplash: CSRD omnibus simplification may cut mandatory demand; VSME voluntary uptake uncertain (verify live).
Unwired feature debt: decarb-simulator/climate-benchmark/data-lineage/product-hotspot built but not shipped → decide ship vs retire (focus + value).
